skills.name: Mining
skills.desc: Increase your ore extraction, improve blast mining, and gain rare minerals useful in crafting.
skills.how: Earn XP by breaking ores and stone with a pickaxe. Naturally-generated blocks only — placed blocks give nothing.
skills.ability: Vein Mining & Drilling — break connected ore veins and tunnel faster.

skills.name: Farming
skills.desc: Increase the bounty of your harvest and animals, safely harvest honey, and collect rare plants and ingredients.
skills.how: Earn XP by harvesting crops, breeding animals, shearing, and collecting from bees & berry bushes.
skills.ability: Replanting & multi-harvest perks reduce manual work and boost yields.

skills.name: Woodcutting
skills.desc: Increase wood harvesting, augment your building skills, and gain more building material from less resources.
skills.how: Earn XP by chopping logs and stripping wood with an axe.
skills.ability: Tree Capitator — fell an entire tree in one swing at higher levels.

skills.name: Digging
skills.desc: Increase your bounty from the earth, find more treasure in archaeology, and sift small items from sand and gravel.
skills.how: Earn XP by digging dirt, sand & gravel with a shovel, and by brushing suspicious blocks (archaeology).
skills.ability: Sifting — chance to find buried items in dug material.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.desc: Get more fish, find sunken treasure, and use bait to pull rare items more frequently.
skills.how: Earn XP per catch. Treasure and rare catches give far more than common fish.
skills.ability: Bait system — consumable bait raises rare-catch odds.

skills.name: Archery
skills.desc: Increase ranged damage, improve accuracy, and kill targets at a safe distance. Slow to train but arguably the strongest skill.
skills.how: Earn XP by hitting and killing mobs with bows and crossbows.
skills.ability: Special arrows, multishot perks, and reduced ammo consumption.
top: XP scales with damage dealt to mobs at range — there is no fixed per-block table; higher-HP mobs and clean hits give the most.

skills.name: Light Weapons
skills.desc: Attack much faster and, with practice, deflect attacks — but weak against heavy plate armor.
skills.how: Earn XP by dealing damage with swords, daggers and rapiers.
skills.ability: Parry / deflect, bleed and crit perks for fast weapons.
top: XP scales with damage dealt in melee with light weapon types.

skills.name: Heavy Weapons
skills.desc: Hit much harder and are more effective against armor, but poor at blocking incoming attacks.
skills.how: Earn XP by dealing damage with axes, greataxes, maces, warhammers and spears.
top: XP scales with damage dealt in melee with heavy weapon types.

skills.name: Light Armor
skills.desc: Improve evasion and stay protected without sacrificing much mobility.
skills.how: Earn XP by taking hits while wearing leather, chainmail or gold armor.
top: XP scales with damage absorbed while wearing light armor.

skills.name: Heavy Armor
skills.desc: Greatly reduce damage taken and become an undefeatable menace, at the cost of some mobility.
skills.how: Earn XP by taking hits while wearing iron, diamond or netherite armor.
skills.ability: Flat damage reduction and knockback-resist perks.
top: XP scales with damage absorbed while wearing heavy armor.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.desc: Make tools and equipment of increasingly superior quality. The core skill of the Classic pack.
skills.how: Earn XP by crafting, quenching, fitting and sharpening gear at the table, cauldron and grindstone.
skills.ability: Quality scaling — higher Smithing level produces stronger gear from the same recipe.

skills.name: Enchanting
skills.desc: Enhance your ability to imbue items with magic on the table and anvil. Achieve enchant levels previously impossible.
skills.how: Earn XP by enchanting items — higher-tier enchants give much more (Silk Touch/Infinity = 1000 base).
skills.ability: Higher max enchant levels and better anvil combining.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.desc: Make potions and poisons of extreme potency, and learn to transmute materials.
skills.how: Earn XP by brewing potions and performing transmutations.
skills.ability: Stronger custom potions, poisons, and material transmutation recipes.
top: XP scales with potions brewed and transmutations performed.

skills.name: Power
skills.desc: Your overall level. Leveling any other skill feeds Power. Spend Power skill points on any perk you've unlocked.
skills.how: Power XP is gained automatically as you earn XP in every other skill. Max level 256.
skills.ability: Grants skill points — the currency you spend in skill trees to unlock perks.

smithSteps.d: Open a crafting table and use the normal vanilla recipe shape (e.g. 2 iron + 1 stick = iron sword). ValhallaMMO automatically intercepts the craft and replaces the result with a quality-scaled version. The quality depends on your current Smithing level — higher level means stronger stats from the same recipe. You'll see XP awarded in chat. The crafted item now has invisible internal tags that enable the rest of the pipeline.

smithSteps.t: Step 2 — Heat the item in a furnace (metal gear only)
smithSteps.d: Take the weapon or armor you just crafted and place it directly into a furnace, blast furnace, or campfire — as if you were smelting it. The item comes back out looking the same, but it now has an invisible 'heated' tag. This is required before quenching. ⚠ Common mistake: do NOT smelt a raw iron/gold ingot and try to use the resulting 'Hot Ingot' for this step. The hot ingots are used for fitting (Step 4), not quenching. You heat the actual weapon/armor piece itself.
smithSteps.tag: Put the ITEM in the furnace input slot

smithSteps.t: Step 3 — Quench in a water cauldron
smithSteps.d: Fill a cauldron with water (right-click with a water bucket). Then drop (press Q / throw) the heated item into the water cauldron. The item will disappear — this is normal, it's 'inside' the cauldron processing for 30 seconds. After 30 seconds the quenched item pops back out with boosted durability and dig speed. Do NOT break the cauldron while it's processing — that cancels the quench and just returns the unmodified item. Awards 300–2,400 Smithing XP.
smithSteps.tag: Drop heated item into water cauldron · wait 30 seconds

smithSteps.t: Step 4 — Fit the armor (armor pieces only, skip for weapons/tools)
smithSteps.d: Open a crafting table and place your Valhalla-crafted armor piece together with its fitting ingredient. This is a shapeless recipe — slot order doesn't matter (except chainmail which uses a cross pattern). The fitting ingredient depends on the armor tier. This scales the armor's protection stats based on your Smithing level.

smithSteps.t: Step 5 — Sharpen (edged weapons and tools only)
smithSteps.d: Walk up to a grindstone and right-click it while holding the weapon or tool you want to sharpen. No extra ingredients needed — just interact with the grindstone while the item is in your hand. This scales attack damage based on your Smithing level. Only works once per item (removes the 'needs sharpening' tag).

Open a crafting table and surround your item with upgrade materials. Each upgrade has a specific ingredient — see the Upgrades page for the full list. Most upgrades can be stacked up to 4 times. You can add more slots with the Bonus Slot upgrades.

Craft an Unstable Diamond first (use the 'destabilize_diamond' recipe at a crafting table). Then use a smithing table: place your diamond item + the Unstable Diamond. The item upgrades to netherite tier, keeping all tags and upgrades.
smithSteps.tag: Smithing table · diamond item + unstable diamond

customItems.name: Hot Iron Ingot
customItems.use: Smelt a raw iron ingot in a furnace/blast furnace/campfire. Used as the fitting ingredient for iron armor. NOT used for quenching.

customItems.name: Hot Gold Ingot
customItems.use: Smelt a raw gold ingot in a furnace/blast furnace/campfire. Used as the fitting ingredient for gold armor. NOT used for quenching.

customItems.name: Hot Netherite Scrap
customItems.use: Smelt netherite scrap in a blast furnace. Used as the fitting ingredient for netherite-tier processes.

customItems.name: Unstable Diamond
customItems.use: Crafted via the 'destabilize_diamond' grid recipe. Used for two things: fitting diamond armor, AND upgrading diamond gear to netherite at the smithing table.
